# Dnsfilter

DNSFilter provides cloud-based DNS security and content filtering solutions to protect networks from online threats and manage internet usage.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/dnsfilter/.

## Actions

- **Create IP Address**: Create a new ip address in dnsfilter.
- **Get Application Category**: Get basic information of a specific application category.
- **Get Billing Information**: Retrieve basic billing information for an organization.
- **Get Category**: Get basic information of a specific category.
- **Get IP Address**: Get basic information of the specified ip address.
- **List All Categories**: List all categories including internal categories.
- **List All IP Addresses**: List all user-associated ip addresses.
- **List All MAC Addresses**: List all mac addresses with basic information.
- **List Application Categories**: List application categories with basic information.
- **List Applications**: List applications with basic information.
- **List Block Pages**: List block pages associated with the current user.
- **List Categories**: List categories with basic information.
- **List Invoices**: List invoices for an organization, most recent first.
- **List IP Addresses**: List user-associated ip addresses basic information.
- **List MAC Addresses**: List mac addresses associated with an organization.
- **List Networks**: List all networks.
- **List Organizations**: List all organizations.
- **Suggest Domain Threat**: Suggest a fqdn as a potential threat.
- **Validate Auth0 JWT**: Validate a jwt with auth0.
